operator_card_render_packet_elioperator_.how_device_awareness_works: Mac chat defaults to compact cards with at most five visible bullets and details collapsed.
operator_card_render_packet_elioperator_.how_truth_flows: Backend readback supplies truth; the render packet references it and carries the semantic card payload.
operator_card_render_packet_elioperator_.next_safe_move: Use the Capital Hilton examples as the semantic contract for future Mac chat rendering.
operator_card_render_packet_elioperator_.plain_summary: Render packets turn backend readback into compact semantic cards for chat without exposing machinery.
operator_card_render_packet_elioperator_.what_this_does_not_do_yet: It does not render UI, generate images, call models, dispatch agents, run workflows, or perform external actions.
operator_card_render_packet_elioperator_.what_this_enables: Any workflow can summon a truth-backed card object that a future visual layer can render.
